description: CloudEvents envelope for a TransferStockAllocationReleased domain event (ADR 0051).

allOf.description: The CloudEvents 1.0 context attributes shared by every message this bounded context emits, in structured-mode JSON. Each concrete event schema composes this with `allOf` and pins `type` to a single value.

id.description: Unique identifier for this event occurrence, a UUID v4. Together with `source` it uniquely identifies the event, which is what consumers deduplicate on.

source.description: The context that emitted the event. Always `/warehouse/inventory-storage` for this service.

type.description: Reverse-DNS event type, of the form `com.warehouse.wms.inventory-storage.<entity>.<EventName>`. Pinned to a single value by each concrete event schema.

subject.description: The id of the aggregate instance this event is about — a reservation id, a StockUnit id, a bin id, or a SKU, depending on the event. Never empty.

time.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the event occurred in the domain, taken from the injected Clock port, not from wall-clock time at publish.

datacontenttype.description: Media type of the `data` member. Always application/json.

dataschema.description: Absolute URI naming the payload shape and version: `urn:warehouse:inventory-storage:<events|analytics>:<EventName>:v<N>`. Pinned per message by each concrete event schema (the `events` variant for StockReserved/ReservationRevoked, `analytics` for the rest; StockReserved and ReservationRevoked also appear on the analytics topic with the `analytics` variant).

data.description: The event payload. Shape is fixed by `dataschema`.

reservation_id.description: The reservation whose hold this release resolved (as named by the command and the allocation ledger).

outcome.description: Closed outcome set; BOTH settle the saga as success. RELEASED: the reservation still held the stock and this revoked it (quantity back in usable). ALREADY_RESOLVED: the reservation had already expired or been confirmed — either way the hold is gone.

reason.description: The command's cancellation reason carried through, or IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT on the answer to a conflicting replay (the original ledger decision stands).
